Sites and safety

Sites on the skip list are never optimized and their requests are never blocked.

Skip list

Site

Per-site settings

Created from the popup with the scope set to "This site". They override the global settings for that site and its subdomains.

SiteModeModules

Always protected

Sign-in, payment and CAPTCHA providers and local development hosts are never optimized and cannot be blocked by custom rules. Pages with password or card fields, CAPTCHA or payment frames, and sign-in or checkout paths are also left alone.

Custom rules

Block requests to a specific host, optionally limited to a path.

Format: a hostname with at least two parts, then an optional path where * is a wildcard. Rules cannot target file names, IP addresses, whole top-level domains, or authentication, payment and CAPTCHA providers. Rules apply to scripts, XHR, frames, images, media and fonts, never to the page itself.

    Privacy and session

    What is stored, where, and for how long.

    What this extension does with data

    Everything runs in your browser. The extension contains no network code of its own: no telemetry, no analytics, no remote rule lists and no backend. It stores your settings and, for each open tab, the site name and the latest measurements, in the browser's session storage. That storage is held in memory and is cleared when the browser closes. A tab's data is deleted when the tab closes. Settings are not written to disk, so they reset at each browser start. Use export and import to keep a copy yourself.

    Permissions and why

      Extension overhead

      The extension measures the time spent inside its own page callbacks and shows it as "Extension time" in the popup. It works in slices of at most 8 ms in idle time, pauses while the tab is hidden, and stops watching a page after one second of cumulative work.

      Manage data

      Clear tab data removes stored measurements, comparisons and tab pauses. Reset everything also restores default settings.
